sources.title: Retrieval | OpenAI API
sources.snippet: The Retrieval API allows you to perform semantic search over your data, which is a technique that surfaces semantically similar results—even when they match few or no keywords. Retrieval is useful on its own, but is especially powerful when combined with our models to synthesize responses. The Retrieval API is powered by vector stores, which serve as indices for your data.
